note: Scored provisionally and with low confidence, because the call was rescheduled after nine minutes before any baseline was taken. What can be assessed: neglected_health is met on the severity test, since there is no crisis and no condition disclosed, and health is plainly the area he let slide during five years of sole childcare. Successful and income are listed as misses on the strict reading that nothing establishes them — his occupation was never determined beyond 'I work from home. Most of my work's done from my phone', no income was discussed and no price was mentioned. That is an absence of evidence rather than evidence of absence, and it should be revisited after the rebooked call rather than treated as settled. Two criteria cannot be assessed at all and are deliberately left off both lists. Good_to_great is genuinely ambiguous: he is a former avid mountain biker who lost five years and is now riding and doing kettlebell work again, which reads as good-to-great, but the trigger was being winded carrying his children upstairs, which reads closer to rescue. Not_deconditioned is similarly unresolvable without age, height, weight or any activity baseline — he mountain bikes and paddleboards, which points away from the exclusion, but the stairs incident points toward it. The one substantive ICP observation available now is about product fit rather than criteria: what he asked for is programming structure, movement variety and dietary guidance, which describes a template or lower-tier product more than six months of one-to-one coaching at $6,000. That question should be settled on Monday before the flagship is pitched, and it is the same routing question the sales manager described internally the previous day when he said prospects who are already active and want structure 'are usually the guys we send to Primal U.'
